jobs.description:
Founded in 1989, Hong Kong Metropolitan University (HKMU) is a modern, vibrant and dynamic university. We tailor our professional programmes to adapt to market trends and meet industry needs, thus providing our students with quality professional education and clear career paths. Being the first University of Applied Sciences (UAS) in Hong Kong, we pledge to play a pioneering role in enhancing recognition of vocational and professional education and training, and nurturing talents with both applied skills and knowledge.
As a faculty-driven, student-centred university in support of innovative teaching and learning, strategic research, and stakeholder outreach to provide maximum benefit to our communities, we conduct research that advances knowledge and enhances teaching, focusing on strategic areas, including digital humanities and literature, international business, gerontechnology, personalised care, smart city, open and innovative education, and bilingual learning and teaching.
HKMU is becoming an ever more vital link in addressing and helping Hong Kong to solve many difficult challenges – as part of our involvement in, and commitment to, the ‘metropolis’ of Hong Kong. Our plans to expand into the Greater Bay Area (GBA) will also cultivate talent to serve Hong Kong and the wider metropolitan GBA.
For more information about the University, please visit https://www.hkmu.edu.hk .

A master’s degree, preferably a doctoral degree in Cosmetic science, Chemistry, Biology, or a related discipline;

Successful candidates will be appointed on a temporary part-time contract. Benefits will be provided in accordance with the statutory provisions.

Applicants should possess a Bachelor’s degree or above in Public Health, Epidemiology, Statistics, Bioinformatics or other fields related to life/medical sciences. They should have hands-on experience in participant recruitment, fieldwork coordination assistance, and clinical or epidemiological data collection. Knowledge or previous experience in research and ultrasound operation is highly preferred. Previous experience in FMD and/or CIMT measurements would be a strong advantage. They should have excellent interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to engage diverse participants and manage and assist with on-site activities and logistics. An excellent command of spoken and written English and Chinese (including fluent Cantonese) is essential. They should have a strong sense of responsibility; be logical, detail-oriented and self-motivated. They should also be able to work independently and as part of a team.
The appointee will assist with on-site activities related to research on the risk of non-communicable diseases in the young adults, with a specific focus on cardiovascular health. Responsibilities include supporting participant recruitment via phone calls, handing out questionnaires, obtaining informed consent, operating ultrasound equipment, and performing other duties as assigned. Training will be provided.
A highly competitive salary commensurate with qualifications and experience will be offered.
The University only accepts online applications for the above post. Applicants should apply online and upload an up-to-date CV. Review of applications will commence as soon as possible and continue until December 20, 2026 , or until the post is filled, whichever is earlier.

jobs.description:
SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
The School of Continuing Education (SCE), one of the seven Faculties/Schools of Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU) and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. SCE also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operating on a self-financed basis, SCE including its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 550 part-time instructors. SCE is inviting applications for the following position:
SCE is at an advanced stage of progressing towards its registration as a post-secondary college under the applicable law, with completion expected to be within a year. This transformation aims to enhance the internationalisation and diversification of higher education through distinctive, professional programmes that address societal manpower needs. As part of this exciting institutional evolution, successful candidates may be offered the opportunity to transition to the new post-secondary college (upon its successful registration) under a long-term development plan.
SCE is inviting applications for the following position:
Information Technology Manager (Campus and IT Services Management) (Ref. No.: 26270281)
Reporting to the Senior Information Technology Manager, the appointee will be responsible for leading, planning, and managing IT services to ensure reliable, secure, and efficient support for academic, administrative, and operational activities. This role bridges technology, facilities-related IT systems, and service delivery to support a modern, digitally enabled campus environment.
Key Responsibilities
Campus Management
Lead digital transformation and smart campus initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and user experience.
Ensure all teaching spaces, computer labs, and meeting rooms are fully functional through proactive monitoring and lifecycle management, focusing on PC performance and AV stability (projectors, displays, audio).
Oversee IT daily help desk operations, acting as a point of escalation for complex technical issues.
Budget Execution & Control
Support the development of the annual IT operating and capital expenditure (OPEX/CAPEX) budget by consolidating inputs from infrastructure, applications, security, and service operations.
Prepare regular financial reports and dashboards for senior management, highlighting trends, risks, and cost drivers.
Ensure IT expenditures are aligned with business priorities, strategic initiatives, and corporate financial policies.
Asset and Contract Lifecycle Management
Maintain an accurate and up-to-date inventory of all IT assets, including hardware, software, cloud subscriptions, and licenses.
Monitor software license usage and compliance, ensuring the organization remains audit-ready at all times.
Track warranty periods, maintenance agreements, support contracts, and subscription expirations to ensure timely renewals and avoid service disruptions.
Implement and continuously improve asset management processes and tools to increase visibility, control, and operational efficiency.
Required skills and experience
7+ years in IT operations and management services, with 2+ years in an IT management or service management role.
Strong expertise in:
Troubleshooting of Windows/macOS and mobile platforms.
AV control systems and video conferencing hardware.
ITSM operations and runbooks for incident management.
Proven experience managing IT budgets, vendors, procurement, and asset lifecycle in a medium to large enterprise environment.
Proven ability to manage hardware, software, license, and subscription inventories.
Experience in contract review, renewal planning, and commercial negotiation with vendors.
Excellent communication, documentation, and vendor management skills.
Language: fluent Cantonese and English preferred.
Education and certifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
Certifications preferred: Microsoft and ITIL;
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to sit for a written test.
Subject to the decision of SCE and the new post-secondary college and other factors which may include (but are not limited to) availability of funding and performance, an offer of appointment may be made by the new post-secondary college (upon its successful registration) following the end of the fixed term contract.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System . Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of applications may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy .
HKBU reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions then applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

jobs.description:
Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
Chair Professor / Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor in Atmospheric Chemistry and Modelling under Strategic Hiring Scheme
(Ref. 261021014)
The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at PolyU enjoys a high international reputation in conducting world-class research for societal benefits and has well established partnerships with the industry and government agencies in Hong Kong and beyond. It is ranked the 2nd best worldwide in Civil Engineering in the U.S. News Best Global Universities Rankings 2026, the 18th in Civil and Structural Engineering and the 34th in Environmental Science in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026 (both ranked No. 1 in Hong Kong). The Department offers academic programmes at various levels (PhD, MSC, BEng, BSc).
The Department currently has about 80 faculty members (more than 40 regular faculty members at Assistant Professor and above levels) and around 40 technical and administrative personnel, and is committed to international standards of excellence in teaching and research. Please visit the website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/cee/ for more information about the Department.
The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is an international city located strategically at the heart of Asia and is the gateway to Chinese Mainland, with excellent transport links to major international cities.
The Department is seeking a highly motivated and suitably qualified individual with research expertise in atmospheric chemistry or physics, AI-driven or process-based atmospheric modelling, health impacts of air pollution, or other related disciplines.
To boost the leadership and impact of PolyU’s research work in areas of significant societal needs and strategic importance, the Strategic Hiring Scheme is introduced to recruit faculty members at all levels and outstanding scholars are invited to join the University under the Strategic Hiring Scheme. Appointees recruited under the Strategic Hiring Scheme should have conducted / led world-leading research that is commensurate with the stage of their academic career.
Duties
The appointees will be required to:
(a) teach at undergraduate and postgraduate levels in related disciplines;
(b) conduct research that leads to publications in top-tier refereed journals and awards of research grants;
(c) undertake research, programme / curriculum development and administration;
(d) supervise student projects and theses;
(e) engage in industrial and scholarly research / consultancy activities;
(f) undertake academic and departmental administrative duties; and
(g) perform any other duties as assigned by the Head of Unit or his delegates.
Qualifications
Applicants should have:
(a) a PhD in Engineering or Science, specialising in Environmental / Atmospheric Sciences, Air Pollution Control, or a related field;
(b) a strong commitment to excellence in teaching and research;
(c) strong records of research, publications and scholarship in atmospheric chemistry and physics, atmospheric modelling, or air pollution control technology;
(d) good networking ability and excellent potential to become a world-leading scholar; and
(e) excellent communication skills and the ability to use English as the medium of instruction.
Applicants for appointment at Chair Professor level should have an outstanding record of global leadership and research achievement in the community, in addition to substantial years of relevant post-qualification experience.
Applicants for appointment at Professor or Associate Professor level should have a substantial number of years of experience and an excellent record of relevant academic and/or research achievement in the specified field. Applicants with less experience will be considered for appointment at the level of Assistant Professor.
Conditions of Service
A highly competitive remuneration package will be offered. Faculty members recruited through the Strategic Hiring Scheme at Chair Professor or Professor level will receive a start-up grant of HKD 5 million or more to support research activities (including the admission of two PhD students, purchase of equipment, hiring of research staff, etc.) in the initial five years, whereas those appointed at Associate Professor or Assistant Professor level will receive a start-up grant of HKD 3 million or more. Initial appointment for Assistant Professor will be on a fixed-term gratuity-bearing contract. Re-engagement thereafter is subject to mutual agreement. An appropriate term will be provided for appointment at Associate Professor / Professor / Chair Professor levels. For general information on terms and conditions for appointment of academic staff in the University, please visit the website at https://www.polyu.edu.hk/hro/docdrive/careers/doc/Prof.pdf .
C onsideration of applications will commence on 20 November 2026 until the positions are filled .
Apply Now

jobs.description:
SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
The School of Continuing Education (SCE), one of the seven Faculties/Schools of Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU) and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. SCE also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operating on a self-financed basis, SCE including its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 550 part-time instructors. SCE is inviting applications for the following position:
SCE is at an advanced stage of progressing towards its registration as a post-secondary college under the applicable law, with completion expected to be within a year. This transformation aims to enhance the internationalisation and diversification of higher education through distinctive, professional programmes that address societal manpower needs. As part of this exciting institutional evolution, successful candidates may be offered the opportunity to transition to the new post-secondary college (upon its successful registration) under a long-term development plan.
SCE is inviting applications for the following position:
Systems Analyst (Application Development & Support) (Ref. No.: 26270115)
The appointee is expected to perform the following duties:
We are building a high‑performance IT team to support the ongoing digital transformation and future growth of the School. We are looking for a strong, motivated candidate who is passionate about application design, system development, and delivering meaningful business impact through technology.
This role offers an opportunity to become a core member of our IT application team, working closely with business stakeholders to enhance mission‑critical systems and deliver modern, scalable solutions. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting, maintaining, and modernizing legacy applications while contributing to new system development, supporting the transformation journey in a complex and evolving environment.
Key Responsibilities:
The candidate will focus on application support, design, development, and system enhancement, contributing to DevOps practices that streamline deployment, improve system stability, and support continuous improvement
Map, analyze, and document interfaces between legacy systems and new platforms, ensuring seamless integration and efficient, reliable data exchange
Perform end‑to‑end software development lifecycle activities, including requirements gathering, system design, development, testing, implementation, and ongoing maintenance
Design and develop innovative application solutions and contribute to product and system enhancement initiatives
Enhance and modernize existing legacy applications to support institutional transformation and evolving operational needs
Prepare and maintain comprehensive testing and system documentation, ensuring quality, reliability, and adherence to delivery timelines
Produce clear and user‑friendly manuals to support effective adoption and optimal utilization of new systems
Collaborate closely with IT colleagues and business users on institution‑wide IT initiatives and projects
Perform other IT projects and assignments as assigned
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or related discipline
At least 5 years of relevant work experience in end‑to‑end application development, covering front‑end, back‑end, and database design and development, with experience in responsive design and system integration. (Candidates with less relevant experience are welcome to apply and may be considered for an associate-level role)
Strong hands-on solid proven experience in the following programming languages: Java, PHP, Python, RESTful API, SQL and shell script;
Good knowledge of any of the following is an advantage: Docker, Kubernetes, MS Power Platform, PowerBuilder, Sybase database, Jira and test automation tools;
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address complex system issues; and
Possess solid written and verbal communication skills to both technical and non-technical audiences, and strong commitment-to-task. Proficiency in both English and Chinese is required.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written assessment.
Subject to the decision of SCE and the new post-secondary college and other factors which may include (but are not limited to) availability of funding and performance, an offer of appointment may be made by the new post-secondary college (upon its successful registration) following the end of the fixed term contract.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System . Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy .
HKBU reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

jobs.description:
Position Summary
Jockey Club 'CoolPlay' Project Phase 2 is generously funded by a HK$64 million donation from the Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust. The project aims to ignite a passion for STEM learning in young children, setting the stage for future STEM education. Through our focus on play and exploration, we aim to enrich children's learning interests, learning attitudes (including resilience), and skills (including observing and predicting).
The Project Manager reports directly to the Project Co-leader and will be supported by a growing community of specially trained educators and experts, engaged parents, as well as the passionate community. With our internationally recognised STEM learning resource kit - JumpStarter, we make exploration easily accessible for everyone.
Job Responsibilities
Ensure that all project outcomes and outputs are delivered on-time, within scope and within budget.
Develop and implement a detailed project plan to monitor and track progress of various project components simultaneously.
Manage changes to the project scope, project schedule and project costs for the rapid changes in the society.
Actively obtain and coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for a smooth implementation of the Project.
Create synergy among the Project team and stakeholders (e.g. funder, partnership schools).
Create and maintain project documentation, including administrative and budget documents requested by the funder.
Job Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in appropriate field of study.
At least 5 years of proven track record in project management.
Experience in managing projects in education or non-profit making sectors is a plus.
Project Management Professional (PMP) or any equivalent qualifications is a plus.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.
Proficient working knowledge of project management tools (e.g. Trello, Microsoft Planner).
Comfortable working in an emerging project backed by information technology.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Chinese.
Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking skills.
A self-motivated leader.
Adaptive to changes.
Salary and Fringe Benefits
Initial appointment will normally be made on a renewable 24+ months contract.
Remuneration is competitive and will be based on qualifications and relevant experience. The College offers group medical insurance and dental, staff development support and annual leave to eligible appointee(s).
Application Procedure
Applicants are invited to:
Submit an application letter with a full Curriculum Vitae, and copies of all graduate transcripts, and the names and contact details of three references.
Specify in the application letter current/latest salary and expected salary
Send applications to the Yew Chung College of Early Childhood Education by email (recruit@yccece.edu.hk).
The College will review applications immediately and applications will be accepted until the posts are filled.  Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Important notes to Applicants
Appointees will undergo a medical check/examination.
Local applicants will undergo the Sexual Conviction Record Check. Overseas applicants will present a police report before appointment can be confirmed.
Reimbursement of the costs as mentioned above subject to a ceiling is applicable.
The College also reserves the right to make an appointment by invitation.
Personal data collected will be used for recruitment-related purposes only.

jobs.description:
Department/Unit: School of Pharmacy
Closing Date: Until the post is filled
Sc hool of Pharmacy at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) invites applications for a tenure track faculty position at the rank of Assistant Professor in the field of Pharmaceutical Sciences. We seek an outstanding and collaborative scholar conducting innovative research in emerging and high-impact areas of pharmaceutical sciences, including, but not limited to:
Advanced Drug Delivery, Biomaterials & Nanomedicine
RNA, Gene & Advanced Therapeutics
AI, Computational Drug Discovery & Bioinformatics
Precision Medicine, Multi-omics & Systems Pharmacology
Biopharmaceutics, Pharmacometrics & Drug Disposition
Outstanding candidates working in other emerging areas that complement or expand the School’s research strengths are also encouraged to apply.
This position offers an outstanding opportunity to develop an independent, externally funded research program within a vibrant academic community. The successful candidate will contribute to the School’s mission of improving patient care and public health through innovative research and education.
Responsibilities:
(a) develop and maintain an independent, rigorous, and externally funded research programme;
(b) publish scholarly work in high-impact, peer-reviewed journals;
(c) contribute to the teaching mission of the School by instructing professional (Bachelor of Pharmacy) and graduate (Master of Science in Pharmaceutical Sciences and Drug Development, MPhil and PhD in Pharmacy) students in relevant areas;
(d) mentor graduate students and postdoctoral fellows;
(e) provide service to the School, College, University, and the broader professional community; and
(f) other academic and professional duties assigned by the School Director.
Required Qualifications:
(i) a PhD or equivalent doctoral degree in pharmaceutical sciences or a closely related discipline;
(ii) a strong record of scholarly achievement, demonstrated by publications in peer-reviewed journals relevant to the stated research fields;
(iii) evidence of potential to secure independent external research funding;
(iv) excellent written and verbal communication skills; and
(v) a commitment to excellence in teaching and mentoring a diverse body of students.
Applicants with the following will have an advantage:
(i) postdoctoral research experience or equivalent;
(ii) a proven record of, or strong potential for, interdisciplinary collaboration; and
(iii) experience in teaching or teaching assistant role in the pharmacy-related fields at the university level.
Review of applications will commence in November 2026 and continue until the post is filled. Candidates will be contacted before references being approached, and all grants will be validated with the appropriate funding agency.
Appointment will normally be made on contract basis for up to three years initially, which, subject to good performance and mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation later.
For enquiries, please contact: pharmacy@cuhk.edu.hk
About the School:
The School of Pharmacy CUHK is a leader in pharmaceutical education, research, and practice. Our faculty members are at the forefront of discovery in drug development, clinical pharmacy, and population-based health sciences. We offer state-of-the-art research facilities, a supportive collegial environment, and strong collaborative ties with our academic medical center, other health science schools, and regional healthcare systems. For more information about our School's education programmes and research, please visit School's website https://www.pharmacy.cuhk.edu.hk .
Application Procedure:
To apply, please submit an online application with the following attachments:
1) a cover letter addressing qualifications and alignment with the position;
2) a statement of research interest and future plan (max 3 pages);
3) a statement of your teaching philosophy and experience (max 2 pages);
4) a comprehensive curriculum vitae; and
5) contact details for at least three professional references.
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk .

jobs.description:
Department of Geography and Resource Management
Associate Professor/ Assistant Professor (Urban Studies)
(Ref. 260001U9) Closing Date: Until the post is filled.
The Department of Geography and Resource Management at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is inviting applications for the post of Associate Professor/ Assistant Professor.
Applicants should possess (i) a doctoral degree; (ii) a strong academic background in one or more of the following fields: urban studies, urban planning, human geography, and related fields; (iii) an outstanding record of research and scholarly achievement commensurate with their career stage, demonstrating research excellence and strong potential for international impact. Relevant professional qualifications and/or professional standing (e.g. membership of the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI), the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS), or equivalent professional bodies), teaching experience in relevant fields, and/or expertise in artificial intelligence will be considered advantageous.
The appointee will be expected to: (a) contribute to curriculum development at the undergraduate and/or postgraduate levels across a range of urban studies themes, including the critical and comparative studies of cities and urbanization; (b) deliver high-quality teaching through innovative, experiential and field-based teaching and supervision of student-led research; (c) conduct high-quality independent research; (d) collaborate with interdisciplinary teams on relevant research projects; (e) undertake administrative service; and (f) foster engagement and collaboration with professional institutions, public agencies, and industry partners.
Appointment will normally be made on a contract basis for up to three years initially, with an expected commencement date of August 2027 or as soon as practicable thereafter. S ubject to performance, funding availability, and mutual agreement, may lead to longer-term appointment or substantiation. A competitive salary and benefits package commensurate with qualifications and experience will be offered.
The Department warmly welcomes applications from outstanding candidates who are passionate about advancing research and education in urban studies and related fields. This is an exciting opportunity to join a department ranked 21st and 5th globally by the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2026 and Shanghai Ranking by Subject 2026 respectively. The Department offers a vibrant and collaborative academic environment with a strong focus on smart, sustainable, and healthy cities. The successful appointee will have the opportunity to pursue impactful research, collaborate with leading scholars, and contribute to our undergraduate and postgraduate programmes, including the Urban Studies Programme co-organised with the School of Architecture.
Application Procedure
The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
For more details about the Department, please visit https://www.grm.cuhk.edu.hk/. For enquiries, please email geography@cuhk.edu.hk.

jobs.description:
Founded in 1994 and awarded the University title in 2016, The Education University of Hong Kong (EdUHK) is a publicly funded
university, dedicated to the advancement of teacher education and related disciplines through a diverse offering of academic,
professional and research programmes. The University aspires to become a leading university in the Asia Pacific region and beyond,
with a focus on educational and multidisciplinary research, development and innovation. We are committed to nurturing outstan ding
and caring educators and professionals as well as enhancing the impact of scholarship.
The University has an academic/teaching staff strength of about 4 60 and total student headcount of about 11,000. It has a Graduate
School and three Faculties, namely, Faculty of Education and Human Development, Faculty of Humanities, and Faculty of Liberal Arts
and Social Sciences, comprising 14 academic departments, as well as two Academies, Academy for Educational Development and
Innovation and Academy for Applied Policy Studies and Education Futures, a number of University-level research centres and Faculty-
level research and professional development centres. For more information about the University, please visit http://www.eduhk.hk.
To continue pursuing excellence in the advancement of knowledge, scholarship and innovation through high quality research, we are
seeking enthusiastic and highly dedicated academics to join the University in support of its strategic development in diverse areas.
Associate Professor / Assistant Professor / Research Assistant Professor (Ref: 2600966)
Department of Social Sciences and Policy Studies
Faculty of Liberal Arts and Social Sciences
The Department of Social Sciences and Policy Studies (SSPS) is a research -intensive department that prides itself on multi -disciplinary
social science research and policy analysis focused on the understanding of social, economic, political and geographical phen omena and
educational issues, as well as their implications and challenges for policy making and changes in local, national and global contexts.
The department’s faculty are engaged in a range of innovative research areas concerning gender, family, youth, community, cit izenship,
minorities, immigration, climate change, sustainability, governance, urban and social policy, business, finance, entrepreneur ship, and
education. The department offers degree programmes at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels.
The Department is seeking inspirational and energetic candidates to join the University in support of its development in the area of
Financial Technology (FinTech).
Successful applicants will join the University’s highly qualified scholarly team and affiliate with the relevant academic dep artment. The
appointee will contribute to enhancing the University's research capacity and impact on the relevant strategic research area( s).
Responsibilities mainly include: (i) conducting high -quality research, securing external research grants, and generating scholarly
publications or other significant research outputs; (ii) strengthening academic and professional networks, including collabor ations with
local and overseas institutions and universities; (iii) providing effective leadership in programme and curriculum developmen t as well
as programme and course management at undergraduate to postgraduate levels; (iv) engaging in and leading research -related activities
with colleagues and RPg students; and (v) participating in and being an active member of the University’s community. The successful
candidates should play an active role in the teaching and/or development of a soon -to-be-developed Master’s programme in this area.
Applicants must hold a doctoral degree in the relevant field. They should be active researchers with proven capacity and potential in
research. Preference will be given to candidates with expertise in one or more areas relevant to FinTech and decision analyti cs,
including FinTech and digital finance; algorithmic trading and quantitative finance; financial econometrics and analytics; bl ockchain,
virtual assets and decentralised finance; RegTech and compliance analytics; financial risk analytics; business and decision a nalytics;
predictive modelling and forecasting; or artificial intelligence, machine learning and data mining for finance and business. Candidates
from academia, industry and the public sector are encouraged to apply. In addition to strong academic credentials, particular value will
be placed on demonstrated achievements in applied research, knowledge transfer, professional practice, financial or business
innovation, the development or deployment of data -driven solutions, industry collaboration, consultancy, policy or regulatory work, or
other forms of professional, societal or economic impact. Applicants should have an excellent command of English. Fluency in
Putonghua is highly desirable, particularly as appointees will be expected to contribute to teaching delivered in Putonghua. Exceptional
candidates without Putonghua fluency may nevertheless be considered. Candidates with international experience would be highly
valued. The appointee may need to travel outside Hong Kong on a need basis.
Applicants for Associate Professor should possess evidence of strong research output and publications in relevant field(s), t ogether with
a strong research track record and impact. Applicants for Assistant Professor / Research Assistant Professor should possess e vidence of
scholarship, research, and publications in the relevant field(s).
For information on the Department of Social Sciences and Policy Studies, please visit: https://www.eduhk.hk/ssps/.

jobs.description:
In a city renowned for its international outlook and connectivity, The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts (HKAPA) plays a unique and influential role in nurturing future generations of performing artists, including performers, practitioners, designers, and technicians. Ranked 10th in the 2026 QS World University Rankings for Performing Arts and 1st in Asia, the Academy and its Schools of Chinese Opera, Dance, Drama, Film & Television, Music, and Theatre & Entertainment Arts form a vibrant centre of practice, production, teaching, and practice-as-research. Its outstanding reputation is reinforced by the quality of its graduates and its partnerships with centres of excellence locally, regionally, and internationally. Through international residencies, visiting artists, and a distinguished alumni network—including some of the most respected professionals in their disciplines—the Academy is committed to training future world-class performers and practitioners.
The School of Film and Television offers major studies in Cinematography, Directing, Editing, Sound Design, Screenwriting, Digital Screen Design and Creative Producing. It is equipped with high level traditional film cameras and a wide range of high-definition (HD) video cameras, professional camera support equipment, digital sound recording systems and digital post-production facilities for picture and sound editing, immersive sound mixing, visual effects design and colour correction. The School houses teaching, screening and production facilities at two campuses. A multi-cam studio called the Screen Production and Research Centre (SPaRC) provides a location for emerging screen practices and interdisciplinary projects.
The Temporary Technician (Film/TV) will provide technical support for day-to-day teaching and learning activities to the School. The postholder will be based at the Academy’s campuses in Wanchai and Pokfulam and should be prepared to work occasionally at other locations, with irregular working hours including evenings, weekends and public holidays, as and when required.
The key responsibilities are as follows:
(a) To set up, operate and maintain digital television studio equipment, including vision switchers, pedestal cameras, sound and lighting systems.
(b) To support networked media storage, IT infrastructure, Virtual Production (VP/XR) and AI-based creative systems, and related production facilities.
(c) To manage online booking systems and provide technical infrastructure support, including network configuration, IP setup, Operational Technology (OT) system administration and system backups.
(d) To ensure the safety, reliability and operational readiness of technical facilities, equipment and resources.
(e) To perform any other duties as assigned by supervisor.
Applicants should have:
(a) 5 subjects at Level 2 or above in the HKDSEE / Grade E or above in the HKCEE including English Language (Syllabus B) and Chinese Language;
(b) Relevant qualification in IT / electrical / electronic maintenance and repair;
(c) Normally 2 years experience in the set up of digital screen design equipment;
(d) Experience in operating and maintaining digital post-production workstations;
(e) Experience in operating Virtual Production (VP) AI-based creative technology systems, Extended Reality (XR) and motion capture systems;
(f) Good communication and problem-solving skills; and
(g) Good written and spoken English and Chinese.
TERMS OF APPOINTMENT
The appointment will be for a period of up to 6 months starting from November 2026. The starting salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Application To apply, please submit a completed Application Form ( click_here ), together with a cover letter, curriculum vitae and copies of academic qualifications , to the Human Resources Office, The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts, No.1 Gloucester Road, Wanchai, Hong Kong, or email ( hro@hkapa.edu ) . The application documents should be combined into one file in PDF format. Please quote reference code 'TempTech(F/TV)' in the Application Form. Review of applications will commence immediately and continue until the position is filled. Early application is strongly recommended. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Excellent interpersonal, communication, and supervisory skills to engage diverse stakeholders across the music, social, cultural, and academic sectors, and

Tung Wah College
Tung Wah College (TWC) is a self-financing tertiary institution incorporated in 2010 by the Tung Wah Group of Hospitals (TWGHs). Drawing on TWGHs’ recognised strengths and expertise in medical and health services, education, and social services, TWC aspires to become a leading University of Applied Sciences in the Asia-Pacific region. By integrating education, research and industry partnerships, TWC nurtures compassionate, innovative leaders who are ready for a changing world. TWC is an approved post-secondary college registered under the Post Secondary Colleges Ordinance (Cap 320). All TWC programmes are accredited by the Hong Kong Council for Accreditation of Academic and Vocational Qualifications (HKCAAVQ).
TWC currently offers postgraduate, degree, sub-degree, and certificate programmes through four Schools: the School of Nursing, the School of Medical and Health Sciences, the School of Management, and the School of Arts and Humanities. The College has a student population of over 6,100. Its programmes cover nursing, gerontology, health information and services management, biomedical science, forensic biomedical science, medical laboratory science, occupational therapy, physiotherapy, radiation therapy, medical imaging, management in social and business sustainability, applied psychology, early childhood education, and other disciplines.
As TWC continues to develop, we plan to introduce new programmes, enhance our teaching and learning facilities and quality, and strengthen our research capabilities in the coming years. We warmly invite suitably qualified candidates to join us on this journey and contribute to the College’s next chapter of development through the following position:
Duties and Responsibilities
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in applying knowledge to advance education, professional practice, and innovative healthcare development. We welcome applicants with expertise in areas such as allied health, biomedical science, forensic Science, medical laboratory science, public health, neuroscience, or sports science. We are also especially interested in candidates who have strengths in Artificial Intelligence (AI), health data analytics, bioinformatics, or digital health for translational, multidisciplinary research. A proven ability to lead curriculum development, secure competitive grants for applied research, and foster strong community and clinical partnerships is highly desirable.
Candidates should be highly self-motivated, be an excellent team player, and eager to contribute to a collaborative, practice-oriented academic setting. The successful candidate is expected to:
Develop and lead high-impact applied and translational research projects that address real-world healthcare challenges;
Secure and manage significant external research funding;
Publish regularly in internationally recognized, high-impact journals while disseminating findings to the wider academic and professional community;
Provide academic leadership in teaching, programme development, and professional accreditation;
Mentor and supervise postgraduate research students and early-career researchers, fostering a dynamic, inclusive research culture;
Actively build and maintain partnerships with local and international healthcare institutions, industry, and the community;
Contribute to strategic planning and continuous improvement of the School and College’s research agenda;
Engage actively in professional organizations, representing the School in relevant academic, clinical, and community networks; and
Perform any other duties as assigned.
Qualifications and Experience Required
A doctoral degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Biomedical Science, Forensic, Medical Laboratory Science, Physiotherapy, Public Health, Sports Science, AI, Health Informatics, or a related field), preferably a PhD.
Demonstrated substantial experience in leadership roles within the tertiary education sector or in professional organizations.
A distinguished record of scholarly achievement commensurate with the rank of Professor.
Extensive experience in tertiary education, including curriculum design, teaching, and programme management.
A strong track record in applied, practice-based research and competitive grant acquisition.
Documented experience in successful supervision of postgraduate students.
Registration or eligibility for registration with the relevant professional body in Hong Kong (where applicable) is an advantage
Application
Salary will be competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience.
To apply, please submit your application via system. The College reserves the right to fill or not to fill the post. Applicants who are not contacted by the College 6 months after the application deadline may consider their applications unsuccessful. For enquiries, please phone or send WhatsApp to 9172-8618.

jobs.description:
Founded in 1989, Hong Kong Metropolitan University (HKMU) is a modern, vibrant and dynamic university. We tailor our professional programmes to adapt to market trends and meet industry needs, thus providing our students with quality professional education and clear career paths. Being the first University of Applied Sciences (UAS) in Hong Kong, we pledge to play a pioneering role in enhancing recognition of vocational and professional education and training, and nurturing talents with both applied skills and knowledge.
As a faculty-driven, student-centred university in support of innovative teaching and learning, strategic research, and stakeholder outreach to provide maximum benefit to our communities, we conduct research that advances knowledge and enhances teaching, focusing on strategic areas, including digital humanities and literature, international business, gerontechnology, personalised care, smart city, open and innovative education, and bilingual learning and teaching.
HKMU is becoming an ever more vital link in addressing and helping Hong Kong to solve many difficult challenges – as part of our involvement in, and commitment to, the ‘metropolis’ of Hong Kong. Our plans to expand into the Greater Bay Area (GBA) will also cultivate talent to serve Hong Kong and the wider metropolitan GBA.
For more information about the University, please visit https://www.hkmu.edu.hk.
Li Ka Shing School of Professional and Continuing Education (LiPACE)
As one of the eight schools of HKMU, LiPACE has a strong track record of serving diverse learner groups in Hong Kong. Established in 1992 as the Centre for Continuing and Community Education, the institution was elevated to an Institute in 2000 and officially named LiPACE. In January 2020, the University Council approved LiPACE’s normalization as a School, marking a major milestone in its development.
As the designated professional and continuing education arm of the University, LiPACE is committed to providing high-quality learning opportunities with a primary focus on Vocational and Professional Education and Training (VPET). This distinctive role differentiates it from the other schools of the University, which primarily offer bachelor’s, master’s, and doctoral programmes through full-time and distance learning modes.
LiPACE’s academic remit and community engagement activities are organized around four key programme areas: (1) Further Education, (2) Access Programmes, (3) Professional and Continuing Education and Corporate Training, and (4) Adult Education. Beyond these core areas, LiPACE actively promotes non-formal learning in the community through targeted projects. In fulfilling the University’s founding mission of “education for all,” LiPACE complements the broader academic offerings by covering a wide range of disciplines and study levels, while serving learners of diverse ages, nationalities, and occupations.
We are now looking for a suitable person to fill the following position(s) in the LiPACE :
Major Duties and Responsibilities
The appointee will be responsible for teaching the following subject areas on a part-time basis.
(A) Full-time Programmes (Higher Diploma) - Daytime Teaching on Weekdays
Supplementary Health Care Subjects (Sociology and Health)
Tourism and Hospitality
(B) Corporate Training Programmes - Daytime Teaching on Weekdays
Medical Law and Ethics for Hong Kong Nurses
Candidates
For (A) Full-time Programmes , candidates should possess the following qualifications, experience and competence:
A relevant higher degree and professional qualifications in the related subject area; and
At least 5 years' relevant working experience.
Candidates with lower qualification but with substantial working experience may also be considered.
For (B) Corporate Training Programmes , candidates should possess the following qualifications, experience and competence:
A degree or higher degree in the related subject area;
A Registered Nurse currently registered with the Nursing Council of Hong Kong (NCHK);
A qualified legal professional. Admission as a Solicitor or Barrister in Hong Kong is highly preferred;
At least 3 years of working or teaching experience related to the subject area prior to the advertisement closing date; and
Teaching or training experience for government departments, public bodies, healthcare institutions, universities, professional associations, or private organisations in related subjects is highly preferred.
Candidates may be invited to have a teaching demonstration during the interview.
Terms and Conditions for Appointment
Successful candidates will be appointed on a temporary part-time contract. Benefits will be provided in accordance with the statutory provisions.
To Apply
Candidates who are interested in joining us may submit their applications via the University's eRecruitment System. Candidates should indicate their interested subject area(s) under "Other Information - Competencies".
The personal data collected will be used for the purpose of considering your application for employment. For details, please refer to the “Personal Data (Privacy) Notice for Job Applicant” on the University’s website. If you are not contacted by the University within eight weeks from the closing date of application, you may assume that your application was unsuccessful.

The School of Continuing Education (SCE), one of the seven Faculties/Schools of Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU) and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. SCE also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operating on a self-financed basis, SCE including its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 550 part-time instructors. SCE is inviting applications for the following position:
SCE is at an advanced stage of progressing towards its registration as a post-secondary college under the applicable law, with completion expected to be within a year. This transformation aims to enhance the internationalisation and diversification of higher education through distinctive, professional programmes that address societal manpower needs. As part of this exciting institutional evolution, successful candidates may be offered the opportunity to transition to the new post-secondary college (upon its successful registration) under a long-term development plan.
SCE is inviting applications for the following position:
Systems Analyst (Infrastructure Engineer) (Ref. No.: 26270287)
The appointee is expected to perform the following duties:
We are building a high-performing IT infrastructure and operations team to support the School's ongoing digital transformation and future growth. We are seeking a motivated and technically capable professional who is passionate about modern IT infrastructure, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, and delivering reliable technology services that enable business success.
This role offers an opportunity to become a core member of the IT infrastructure team, reporting to Information Technical Manager, working closely with users, application team, vendors, and technology partners to maintain and enhance the School's Microsoft ecosystem, network environment, and security posture. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting day-to-day IT operations, administering Microsoft 365 and hybrid identity platforms, managing network and server infrastructure, and contributing to infrastructure modernization initiatives that support the School's evolving digital landscape.
Key Responsibilities:
Core Infrastructure Management: Support deployment, configuration, and maintenance of Microsoft infrastructure including Windows Server, AD DS, Entra ID, Group Policy, and Intune.
M365 Administration: Manage daily operations of Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and OneDrive, ensuring service health, configuration accuracy, and policy compliance.
Routine Server Operation: Conduct daily health checks, including reviewing logs, backups, disk usage, and service status. Perform housekeeping tasks, monitor server room equipment (power, cooling, cabling), and report abnormalities to ensure availability and proper functioning.
Managing Network infrastructure: Deploy and maintain network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and other network devices to ensure optimal performance and security.
Performance Monitoring: Monitor system and network performance, identify and resolve issues to minimize downtime and maintain service availability.
Updates and Maintenance: Participate in system and network updates and maintenance activities , including patch management and routine system upgrades.
IT projects support: Assist with documentation, testing, and deployment activities. Contribute to initiatives such as SSO integration and system improvements.
Perform ad hoc assignments and responsibilities requested by supervisor.
Required skills and experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
At least 5 years of hands-on working experience in supporting Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, DNS, GPOs, Exchange & SharePoint Online, MS Teams, Intune, Cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS).
Solid experience in managing enterprise network environment, including switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless infrastructure.
Solid understanding of cybersecurity technologies and best practices, including Microsoft Defender, EDR, SIEM, vulnerability management, and endpoint protection.
Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently manage incidents and deliver end-to-end solutions.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address complex system issues; and
Possess solid written and verbal communication skills to both technical and non-technical audiences, and strong commitment-to-task. Proficiency in both English and Chinese is required.
Professional certifications are highly desirable, including: Microsoft, public cloud (Azure/AWS), VMware, ITIL; CISSP is a plus.
Candidates with more extensive experience may be considered for the position of Assistant Information Technology Manager (Infrastructure).
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to sit for a written test.
Subject to the decision of SCE and the new post-secondary college and other factors which may include (but are not limited to) availability of funding and performance, an offer of appointment may be made by the new post-secondary college (upon its successful registration) following the end of the fixed term contract.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

Applications are invited for appointment as Part-time Teaching Assistant in the School of Future Media (Ref.: 537722) for Semester 2 of the 2026–27 academic year, from January to May 2027.
The appointee will support the undergraduate Common Core course CCAI9034 Digital Health Citizen in the Age of AI: Communicating for Health and Wellbeing. The course explores how health information and AI shape personal choices and community wellbeing. Students learn to evaluate digital health information, recognise misinformation and bias, and design ethical, audience-centred health messages through case studies and AI-assisted campaign projects.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct tutorials and practical sessions: Lead discussions and hands-on activities on health communication, digital health literacy and AI; guide case analyses and campaign projects; and provide individual support with concepts introduced in lectures.
Grade and provide feedback: Assess student work in coordination with the instructor, give constructive feedback, and respond to questions about assignments and course concepts.
Support course administration and management: Help prepare, update and organise course materials and resources, including on Moodle, and assist with classroom activities and assessments.
Foster an inclusive learning environment: Encourage participation from students of diverse backgrounds and support collaborative projects and engaging tutorial discussions.
Maintain communication with the instructor: Report on student progress, attend meetings as needed, flag classroom issues, and keep abreast of relevant developments in AI and health communication.
Requirements
Applicants should hold a bachelor’s degree in journalism, communication, media studies, psychology, sociology, public health, or a related field.
Strong command of written and spoken English.
Professional or academic experience with AI and/or health communication is preferred.
Working Hours and Compensation
The position requires approximately 8 hours per week. The appointee must attend lectures on Wednesdays, 15:00–16:50, and lead assigned tutorials scheduled on Thursdays and Fridays. Duties also include preparation, grading and course administration within the weekly workload.
Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience, calculated on an hourly basis.
How to Apply
The University only accepts online applications for the above post. Applicants should upload an up-to-date C.V. and a cover letter. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until November 30, 2026 .

Being the first University of Applied Sciences (UAS) in Hong Kong, we pledge to play a pioneering role in enhancing recognition of vocational and professional education and training, and nurturing talents with both applied skills and knowledge.

For more information about the University, please visit https://www.hkmu.edu.hk .
We are now looking for a suitable person to fill the following position in the School of Nursing and Health Sciences :
Major Duties and Responsibilities
The appointee will assist the Principal Investigator in coordinating a research project entitled "Psychometric validation of OPTION-5 and OPTION-12: Measurement of Shared Decision Making in Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy".
The appointee will be responsible mainly for the following:
conducting literature review on shared decision making and psychometric validation of observer-based measures;
recruiting research participants (musculoskeletal physiotherapists and patients) and obtaining written informed consent;
assisting in audio-recording of musculoskeletal physiotherapy consultations in public and private outpatient settings;
assisting in data collection, including coding of consultations using the OPTION-5 and OPTION-12 scales and administration of the SDM-Q-9 questionnaire;
assisting in expert panel activities for content validity and contextual adaptation;
performing data entry, de-identification and secure data management, and quantitative data analysis (e.g. reliability and factor analysis); and
= providing research-related assistance.
He/she will be normally assigned to work less than 68 hours per four consecutive weeks.
Candidates
Candidates should possess the following qualifications, experience and competence:
a recognized Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, social science, psychology, statistics or related disciplines;
experience in clinical research or data collection in healthcare settings, and registration as a physiotherapist or knowledge of musculoskeletal physiotherapy, will be an advantage;
proficient in MS Office Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; proficient in statistical software will be an advantage;
a good command of written and spoken English and Chinese (including Cantonese); and
a good team player and able to coordinate research projects independently.
Terms and Conditions for Appointment
Successful candidate will be appointed on a temporary part-time contract for up to 10 months. Benefits will be provided in accordance with the statutory provisions.

jobs.description:
In a city renowned for its international outlook and connectivity, The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts (HKAPA) plays a unique and influential role in nurturing future generations of performing artists, including performers, practitioners, designers, and technicians. Ranked 10th in the 2026 QS World University Rankings for Performing Arts and 1st in Asia, the Academy and its Schools of Chinese Opera, Dance, Drama, Film & Television, Music, and Theatre & Entertainment Arts form a vibrant centre of practice, production, teaching, and practice-as-research. Its outstanding reputation is reinforced by the quality of its graduates and its partnerships with centres of excellence locally, regionally, and internationally. Through international residencies, visiting artists, and a distinguished alumni network—including some of the most respected professionals in their disciplines—the Academy is committed to training future world-class performers and practitioners.
The School of Dance offers full-time programmes from sub-degree Diploma to MFA level, and a proposed new doctoral degree, together with its part-time Gifted Young Dancer Programme. In keeping with its conservatoire status, the School's philosophy is centred around performance practice and reflects the unique cultural mix of Hong Kong, emphasising both Chinese and Western traditions. Our graduates are versatile and work across genres/styles, media and forms; and the integration of core contextual knowledge and performance practice as theory and practice forms the uniqueness of the School’s programmes.
The Head of Chinese Dance reports to the Dean of the School of Dance. This position entails providing pedagogic, creative and artistic leadership across all levels and courses in Chinese Dance offered by the School. Responsibilities include curriculum development for the Chinese Dance programmes and the selection and development of repertoire for public performances and tours. Additionally, the Head will provide administrative support to the Dean in matters of scheduling, course evaluation, assessment, student mentoring, committee work, staff development, and planning.
The Head of Chinese Dance will be required to teach Chinese Dance specialisation related courses. The successful candidate will serve on the School’s Management Committee and lead the Chinese Dance department. The Head will be expected to play a strategic role in the further development of Chinese Dance within the School, aligning with the Academy’s new strategic plan and School priorities, particularly concerning research in practice-based programmes.
The Head will also be committed to fostering strong connections with the professional dance community at local, regional and international levels, engaging in professional development, and staying current with trends in professional dance training and scholarship. Additional duties may be assigned by the Dean from time to time.
Applicants should have:
(a) Advanced academic qualifications (preferably a recognised university degree) in Chinese Dance, Dance Education or an equivalent discipline;
(b) Normally, a minimum of eight years’ experience in teaching in Chinese Dance specialisation, including teaching at University and Master’s level;
(c) Substantial academic leadership and administrative/management experience in a Chinese Dance specialisation or equivalent;
(d) A distinguished profile and professional achievement in Chinese Dance as a performer, choreographer, educator and director;
(e) Strong knowledge of Chinese Dance pedagogy, technique, repertoire, performance practice and contemporary developments in dance training;
(f) Excellent organisational, leadership and stakeholder management skills;
(g) Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to work in a multicultural environment; and
(h) Excellent command of spoken and written English.
Additional Desirable Criteria:
(a) Proficiency in spoken and written Chinese; and
(b) Established networks within the local, Chinese Mainland and overseas Chinese Dance communities.
TERMS OF APPOINTMENT
Appointment will be on a two-year renewable contract, subject to performance and mutual agreement. A gratuity payment may be granted upon satisfactory completion of the full contract. Fringe benefits include leave, medical, and dental benefits. The starting salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. A non-accountable Cash Allowance will be provided to the eligible appointee. The expected commencement date will be September 2027.
Application To apply, please submit a completed Application Form (click here ), together with a cover letter, curriculum vitae and copies of academic qualifications, to the Human Resources Office, The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts, No.1 Gloucester Road, Wanchai, Hong Kong, or email ( hro@hkapa.edu ) on or before 22 November 2026. The application documents should be combined into one file in PDF format. Please quote reference code 'H(CD)' in the Application Form. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
HKAPA is an equal opportunity employer.
Personal data collected will be used for recruitment-related purposes only.

Aged 18 years or above;
Generally healthy and able to lie on the couch and change position comfortably during sessions;
Willing to expose relevant body areas with appropriate draping to preserve privacy; and

•　年滿 18 歲或以上。

Tung Wah College
Tung Wah College (TWC) is a self-financing tertiary institution incorporated in 2010 by the Tung Wah Group of Hospitals (TWGHs). Drawing on TWGHs’ recognised strengths and expertise in medical and health services, education, and social services, TWC aspires to become a leading University of Applied Sciences in the Asia-Pacific region. By integrating education, research and industry partnerships, TWC nurtures compassionate, innovative leaders who are ready for a changing world. TWC is an approved post-secondary college registered under the Post Secondary Colleges Ordinance (Cap 320). All TWC programmes are accredited by the Hong Kong Council for Accreditation of Academic and Vocational Qualifications (HKCAAVQ).
TWC currently offers postgraduate, degree, sub-degree, and certificate programmes through four Schools: the School of Nursing, the School of Medical and Health Sciences, the School of Management, and the School of Arts and Humanities. The College has a student population of over 6,100. Its programmes cover nursing, gerontology, health information and services management, biomedical science, forensic biomedical science, medical laboratory science, occupational therapy, physiotherapy, radiation therapy, medical imaging, management in social and business sustainability, applied psychology, early childhood education, and other disciplines.
As TWC continues to develop, we plan to introduce new programmes, enhance our teaching and learning facilities and quality, and strengthen our research capabilities in the coming years. Duties and Responsibilities

supporting the administration of scholarship and student finance; and
assisting in the development and review of the student information systems
performing any other duties as assigned.

possess a recognized Bachelor’s degree with at least 3 years of relevant experience gained in tertiary institutions;

possess good planning, problem-solving, interpersonal and organization skills;
have good command of both written and spoken English and Chinese, fluency in Putonghua would be an advantage; and

Tung Wah College
Established by Tung Wah Group of Hospitals (“TWGHs”) in 2010, Tung Wah College (TWC) is a self-financing degree-granting institution registered under the Post Secondary Colleges Ordinance (Cap.320). Following the educational ideals of TWGHs and leveraging on its renowned strengths and expertise, TWC aims to provide high quality tertiary education to nurture competent, socially responsible and caring professionals for the benefits of society.
With the staunch support of TWGHs, TWC has been developing rapidly and built up a niche in healthcare education. It is the first self-financing tertiary institution offering six professionally accredited degrees to train nurses and allied health professionals such as medical laboratory technologists, occupational therapists, diagnostic radiographer, therapeutic radiographer and physiotherapists. Besides, the College is also the first institution registered under Cap. 320 offering early childhood education degree and higher diploma programmes to train qualified kindergarten teachers and childcare professionals.
Currently, TWC has 4 schools (namely School of Arts and Humanities, School of Management, School of Medical and Health Sciences, and School of Nursing) running a total of 20 doctoral degree, bachelor degree, sub-degree, diploma and certificate programmes in various disciplines. It has a student population of around 5,000 in 2025/2026 and nurtured more than 7,200 graduates since its inception in 2010.
Being a young and vibrant institution, TWC aspires to become a leading private university in the long term. It is planning to launch a number of new programmes, strengthen teaching and learning facilities and quality, and enhance research capability etc. in coming years. To cope with its continuous development, we are now inviting highly qualified candidates to fill the following post:

Coordinate programme accreditation exercises and the development of new academic programmes, ensuring alignment with institutional and regulatory requirements.
Oversee learning, teaching, and academic programme administration, including the effective delivery of administrative support across all School programmes.

Literacy in computer applications, knowledge of PowerPoint, Photoshop, Illustrator and Chinese word processing would be an advantage;

Lingnan University Creative and Cultural Innovation Research Institute is an institutional organization that aims to promote cultural innovation and creative industry research, organize international forums and youth development programmes in Greater Bay Area. Full-time/Part-time Senior Research Assistant / Research Assistant I / Research Assistant II in Economics, Faculty of Business and Economics (Ref.: 537873)
We now invite applications for the captioned post(s).
Duties and Responsibilities
The appointee will primarily assist with academic research in macroeconomics and international economics. Research responsibilities may include conducting literature reviews and background research, collecting and managing data, solving macroeconomic models, writing and debugging research code, and preparing and reviewing presentation slides, exercises, draft manuscripts, and other academic materials as required.
Familiarity with graduate-level macroeconomics or dynamic models and experience with programming or statistical software such as MATLAB, Python, or Stata would be helpful, but they are not required. Experience in writing code to collect and analyze information from online sources, or familiarity with the responsible use of AI tools for research, would also be welcome. More importantly, applicants should be motivated to learn new methods and tools, attentive to detail, and committed to producing accurate and reliable work.
The position may be particularly valuable for candidates considering further study or a research-oriented career in economics. The working language will be English. Further information about potential research topics is available on my website:
https://sites.google.com/site/wataruecon/research
Requirements
Applicants should possess a PhD degree, a Master’s degree, or a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Economics, Finance, Statistics, or a related field, or demonstrate equivalent knowledge and research ability. Candidates should have strong quantitative and analytical skills and be able to work independently. Applicants should be able to make a substantial and consistent time commitment equivalent to at least three working days per week, with greater availability preferred.
What We Offer
The appointment will commence as soon as possible for three months on a temporary full-time or part-time basis, with the possibility of renewal subject to satisfactory performance, operational needs, and funding availability. A high competitive salary commensurate with qualifications and experience will be offered, in addition to annual leave and medical benefits in accordance with the University’s policies.
How to Apply
The University only accepts online application for the above post(s). Applicants should apply online at the University’s careers site ( https://jobs.hku.hk ) and upload an up-to-date CV. Applicants should submit a brief statement explaining their interest in the position and their expected weekly availability. They are also encouraged to provide supporting materials demonstrating relevant research, quantitative, programming, or AI-related skills. Review of applications will start as soon as possible and continue until December 15, 2026, or until the post(s) is/are filled, whichever is earlier. Early applications are encouraged.
Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by email and may be invited to an online interview or a selection exercise. Enquiries about the position should be sent to Dr. Wataru MIYAMOTO at wataru@hku.hk .
